title: What Did You Do?
ringkas: Simple past tense, kata kerja tidak beraturan, dan recount text
goals: menceritakan kejadian yang sudah lewat dengan **simple past tense**
memakai [[was]] dan [[were]], serta kata kerja **-ed** yang beraturan
mengenal kata kerja **tidak beraturan**: [[went]], [[ate]], [[saw]], [[bought]], dan lainnya
membuat kalimat negatif dengan [[did not]] dan pertanyaan dengan [[Did ...?]]
memakai kata waktu lampau: [[yesterday]], [[last week]], [[two days ago]]

lesson.text: Apa yang kamu lakukan **kemarin**? Atau saat **liburan** lalu? Untuk bercerita tentang hal yang sudah terjadi, kita memakai **simple past tense**. Di **Unit 1 Kelas 8** kamu belajar menceritakan pengalamanmu.

lesson.title: 1. Kapan memakai simple past?
lesson.text: Pakai simple past untuk kejadian yang **sudah selesai** di masa lalu, dengan waktu yang jelas.
table: tadi malam / minggu lalu / bulan lalu / tahun lalu
[[I woke up at five this morning.]]

lesson.title: 2. Was dan were (past dari to be)
lesson.text: Kamu sudah kenal am/is/are. Bentuk lampaunya:
table: [[I was tired yesterday.]] / [[She was at home.]]

examples.en: [[Were you at school yesterday?]] — [[No, I wasn't. I was sick.]]
examples.id: Apakah kamu di sekolah kemarin? — Tidak. Aku sakit.

lesson.title: 3. Kata kerja beraturan: tambah -ed
lesson.text: Untuk kebanyakan kata kerja, bentuk lampau = kata dasar + **-ed**. Bentuknya **sama untuk semua subjek** (I, you, he, she, we, they).
table: play → played, walk → walked, visit → visited, help → helped
like → liked, dance → danced, live → lived
study → studied, carry → carried, cry → cried
Satu suku kata, pola konsonan-vokal-konsonan → gandakan konsonan

lesson.title: Cara membaca -ed
lesson.text: Akhiran **-ed** dibaca tiga cara: /t/ ([[walked]]), /d/ ([[played]]), dan /ɪd/ ([[wanted]], [[visited]]). Klik kata-kata itu untuk mendengarnya.

lesson.title: Cara menghafal
lesson.text: Kata kerja tidak beraturan harus **dihafal**. Mulai dari yang sering dipakai (go, have, eat, see, buy) dan ulangi tiap hari. Cobalah menulis 5 kata kerja baru setiap hari di kartu kecil.

lesson.title: 5. Kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan
lesson.text: Gunakan **did** (untuk semua subjek). Setelah did, kata kerja kembali ke **bentuk dasar**.

lesson.title: 6. Kata tanya di masa lampau
lesson.text: Di simple past, kata tanya diletakkan **di depan Did** (untuk kata kerja biasa) atau **di depan was/were**. Setelah Did, kata kerja kembali ke **bentuk dasar**.

lesson.title: Did + kata kerja dasar
lesson.text: Salah: *Where did you went?* Benar: [[Where did you go?]]. Salah: *When you arrived?* Benar: [[When did you arrive?]]. Bila **Who** menjadi pelaku, tanpa did: [[Who broke the window?]]

lesson.title: Used to: kebiasaan di masa lalu
lesson.text: **used to + kata kerja dasar** dipakai untuk kebiasaan atau keadaan di masa lalu yang **sekarang sudah tidak lagi**.
table: [[I used to play football every day.]]

examples.en: [[We used to live in Medan, but now we live in Bandung.]]
examples.id: Dulu kami tinggal di Medan, tetapi sekarang kami tinggal di Bandung.

examples.en: [[He used to be shy, but now he is confident.]]
examples.id: Dulu dia pemalu, tetapi sekarang dia percaya diri.

lesson.title: Setelah did, used berubah menjadi use
lesson.text: Positif: [[I used to swim.]] Negatif dan tanya: [[I didn't use to swim.]] / [[Did you use to swim?]] (bukan *didn't used to*). Jangan tertukar dengan **be used to + V-ing** = terbiasa: [[I am used to getting up early.]]

lesson.title: Hanya satu yang berubah ke lampau
lesson.text: Setelah **did**, kata kerjanya kembali ke bentuk dasar. Benar: [[Did you go?]] Salah: *Did you went?* Benar: [[I didn't eat.]] Salah: *I didn't ate.*
Untuk **to be** (was/were), tidak pakai did: [[Was he sick?]] dan [[They weren't at home.]]

**Recount text** menceritakan kembali pengalaman di masa lalu. Strukturnya: **Orientation** (siapa, kapan, di mana), **Events** (kejadian berurutan), dan **Re-orientation** (kesimpulan atau perasaan di akhir). Kata urutan yang berguna: [[first]], [[then]], [[after that]], [[finally]].

lines.en: Last holiday, my family and I went to Yogyakarta. We traveled by train.
lines.id: Libur lalu, keluargaku dan aku pergi ke Yogyakarta. Kami naik kereta. (Orientation)

lines.en: First, we visited Borobudur Temple. Then we ate gudeg for lunch. After that, we bought some souvenirs in Malioboro.
lines.id: Pertama kami mengunjungi Candi Borobudur. Lalu kami makan gudeg. Setelah itu kami membeli oleh-oleh di Malioboro. (Events)

lines.en: Finally, we went back to the hotel. I was very tired, but I was happy.
lines.id: Akhirnya kami kembali ke hotel. Aku sangat lelah, tetapi aku senang. (Re-orientation)

lines.en: What did you do last weekend, Tom?
lines.id: Apa yang kamu lakukan akhir pekan lalu, Tom?

lines.en: I went to the beach with my family. We swam and played volleyball.
lines.id: Aku pergi ke pantai dengan keluargaku. Kami berenang dan bermain voli.

lines.en: Sounds fun! Did you eat seafood?
lines.id: Kedengarannya seru! Apakah kamu makan seafood?

lines.en: Yes, I did. It was delicious. And you?
I stayed at home. I read a novel and helped my mother.
lines.id: Aku di rumah. Aku membaca novel dan membantu ibuku.

items: Simple past untuk kejadian yang sudah selesai: [[yesterday]], [[last week]], [[two days ago]].
to be: [[was]] (I, he, she, it) dan [[were]] (you, we, they).
Beraturan: kata dasar + **-ed**. Tidak beraturan: dihafal ([[go → went]], [[eat → ate]]).
Negatif: [[didn't]] + kata kerja dasar. Pertanyaan: [[Did]] + subjek + kata kerja dasar.

Last Sunday, my family went to Pangandaran Beach. We left home at six in the morning and arrived at nine.
My brother and I swam in the sea, and my parents sat under a tree. We ate grilled fish for lunch. In the afternoon, I took many photos. We got home late at night and we were very tired.

Yesterday, Tom lost his wallet on the bus. He looked for it in his bag, but he did not find it. He felt worried because his student card was inside.
Then a kind woman called him. She found the wallet under a seat. Tom met her at the bus station and thanked her. He gave her a box of cookies.

Di halte bus, Rani melihat ke keranjangnya, tetapi dompetnya tidak ada. Dia merasa khawatir. Ibunya menelepon warung itu, dan penjual menemukan dompet di bawah kursi. Mereka kembali, mengambilnya, dan berterima kasih padanya.

Last Saturday, Rani went to the market with her mother. They bought vegetables and fruit, and they ate noodles at a small stall. Then Rani saw a boy with a blue bag.
At the bus stop, Rani looked in her basket, but her purse was not there. She felt worried. Her mother called the stall, and the seller found the purse under a chair. They went back, took it, and thanked him.

On Monday, Rani asks Tom about the weekend. "Did you go to Dina's party?" "No, I didn't. I stayed at home because I had a cold." "What did you do?" "I watched TV and drank hot tea. My mother made soup."
"Did you take your medicine?" "Yes, I did. I took it three times a day." "Did you miss anything at school?" "I didn't miss much, but I didn't finish my homework." Rani smiles. "Don't worry. Our teacher gave us extra time."

Dina: Tom, what happened to your arm?
Tom: I fell off my bike yesterday. I was riding fast, and I did not see a hole in the road.
Dina: Oh no! Did you go to the doctor?

Sabtu lalu, Dina dan keluarganya pergi ke Danau Toba. Mereka berangkat dari rumah pukul enam pagi dan bepergian dengan mobil. Di perjalanan, mereka berhenti di restoran kecil di sebuah desa dan sarapan.
Mereka tiba di danau pada siang hari. Dina berenang di air bersama adiknya, sementara orang tuanya duduk di atas tikar di bawah pohon. Pada malam hari, mereka kembali ke hotel di atas bukit. Pada hari Minggu, mereka terbang pulang dari Medan ke Jakarta.

read.text:
Last Saturday, Dina and her family went to Lake Toba. They left home at six o'clock in the morning and traveled by car. On the way, they stopped at a small restaurant in a village and had breakfast.
They arrived at the lake at noon. Dina swam in the water with her brother, while her parents sat on a mat under a tree. In the evening, they returned to the hotel on the hill. On Sunday, they flew back from Medan to Jakarta.
read.title: A Trip to the Lake

I didn't drink ___ juice.
There wasn't ___ juice left.

qs.answer: I ate a lot of cake.
qs.exp: Urutan: I ate a lot of cake.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Aku makan banyak kue."

read.text:
Tom: Did you eat much at the party?
Dina: I ate a lot of cake. I didn't drink any juice.
Tom: There wasn't much juice left.
Dina: Yes, and there weren't many cups.
Tom: But we had some fun.
read.title: What We Ate Yesterday

read.focus: Conjunction: and, but, or, so, because
read.id:
Tom: Kemarin kami pergi ke pantai. Sebelum berangkat, aku mengemas makanan.
Dina: Apakah kamu berenang?
Tom: Tidak, karena hujan. Setelah hujan berhenti, kami bermain sepak bola. Ketika kami sampai di rumah, kami lelah, jadi kami tidur lebih awal.

qs.exp: Tom: "After the rain stopped, we played football".
qs.q: What did they do after the rain stopped?

options: We were tired, because we slept early.
We were tired, so we slept early.
I packed some food before we left.
After the rain stopped, we played football.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "I packed some food ___ we left."
___ the rain stopped, we played football.
We were tired, ___ we slept early.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Tidak, karena hujan."

read.text:
Tom: Yesterday we went to the beach. Before we left, I packed some food.
Dina: Did you swim?
Tom: No, because it rained. After the rain stopped, we played football. When we got home, we were tired, so we slept early.
read.title: Yesterday's Trip

read.focus: Modal verbs: can, must, should, could, may
read.id:
Tom: Kemarin aku tidak bisa menemukan PR-ku. Seharusnya aku memeriksa tasku.
Dina: Apakah kamu bisa mengerjakannya lagi?
Tom: Tidak bisa, karena aku terlalu lelah. Aku harus menjelaskan kepada guru.
Dina: Seharusnya kamu bertanya kepadaku. Aku bisa membantumu.

qs.q: Why couldn't Tom do the homework again?

options: I should have checked my bag.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "I ___ find my homework yesterday. (tidak bisa)"
You should ___ asked me.
I ___ have helped you. (sebenarnya bisa)

qs.answer: I should have checked my bag.
qs.exp: Urutan: I should have checked my bag.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Seharusnya aku memeriksa tasku."

read.text:
Tom: Yesterday I couldn't find my homework. I should have checked my bag.
Dina: Could you do it again?
Tom: I couldn't, because I was too tired. I had to explain to the teacher.
Dina: You should have asked me. I could have helped you.
read.title: A Bad Day

read.id:
Tom: Kemarin aku bertemu seorang pria yang berbicara tiga bahasa. Dia memberiku buku yang dia tulis. Kami mengunjungi kafe tempat kami pertama bertemu.
Dina: Pelayan yang melayanimu adalah sepupuku.
Tom: Dia membawa kopi yang kupesan.

qs.q: What did the man give Tom?

options: I met a man which spoke three languages.
I met a man who spoke three languages.
He gave me a book which he wrote.
He brought the coffee that I ordered.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "We visited the cafe ___ we first met."
The waiter ___ served you was my cousin.
He brought the coffee ___ I ordered.

qs.answer: He gave me a book which he wrote.
qs.exp: Urutan: He gave me a book which he wrote.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia memberiku buku yang dia tulis."

read.text:
Tom: Yesterday I met a man who spoke three languages. He gave me a book which he wrote. We visited the cafe where we first met.
Dina: The waiter who served you was my cousin.
Tom: He brought the coffee that I ordered.
read.title: Yesterday

read.id:
Tom: Kemarin jendela dipecahkan oleh sebuah bola. Pecahan kaca disapu.
Dina: Anak laki-laki itu disuruh meminta maaf.
Tom: Jendela baru dipesan.
Dina: Jendela itu dipasang pagi ini.

qs.q: What broke the window?

options: The window was break by a ball.
The window was broken by a ball.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "The boy ___ told to say sorry."
The window was ___ by a ball.
A new window was ___.

read.text:
Tom: Yesterday the window was broken by a ball. The glass was swept up.
Dina: The boy was told to say sorry.
Tom: A new window was ordered.
Dina: It was fitted this morning.
read.title: What Happened

read.id: Tom: Dina bilang dia mengunjungi neneknya hari sebelumnya. Dia memberitahuku bahwa dia memasak makan siang. Aku bertanya apakah dia menikmatinya. Dia bilang dia menyukainya. Dia berjanji mengajakku lain kali.

qs.exp: Tom: "She promised to take me next time".
qs.q: What did Dina promise?

qs.exp: Past → past perfect; yesterday → the day before.
options: Dina said that she visited her grandmother yesterday, had.
Dina said that she had visited her grandmother the day before.
She told me that she had cooked lunch.
She promised to take me next time.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Dina said that she ___ visited her grandmother."
She visited her grandmother the day ___.
I asked ___ she had enjoyed it.

qs.answer: She said that she had loved it.
qs.exp: Urutan: She said that she had loved it.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia bilang dia menyukainya."

read.text: Tom: Dina said that she had visited her grandmother the day before. She told me that she had cooked lunch. I asked if she had enjoyed it. She said that she had loved it. She promised to take me next time.
read.title: Yesterday's News

read.id:
Tom: Kemarin lebih panas daripada hari ini. Itu hari terpanas tahun ini.
Dina: Aku sampai rumah lebih awal daripada biasanya.
Tom: Pestanya lebih baik daripada yang kuduga.
Dina: Itu pesta terbaik yang pernah ada.

qs.exp: Tom: "It was the hottest day of the year".
qs.q: What was the hottest day of the year?

options: The party was more better than I expected.
The party was better than I expected.
It was the best party ever.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct word: "Yesterday was ___ than today."
It was the ___ party ever.
I got home ___ than usual.

qs.answer: It was the best party ever.
qs.exp: Urutan: It was the best party ever.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Itu pesta terbaik yang pernah ada."

read.text:
Tom: Yesterday was hotter than today. It was the hottest day of the year.
Dina: I got home earlier than usual.
Tom: The party was better than I expected.
Dina: It was the best party ever.

Dina: Aku ingat mengunci pintuku.

Tom: If I had woken up earlier, I would have caught the bus.
Dina: If you had called me, I would have waited.
Tom: If I hadn't forgotten my phone, I would have called.
Dina: If you had told me, I would have helped.
Tom: If I had known, I wouldn't have worried.
read.title: What Happened
When Mom Was Young
read.text:
Dina: Mom, did you use to play outside?
Mother: Yes, I used to play with my friends every afternoon.
Dina: Did you use to have a phone?
Mother: No, we didn't use to have phones. We used to write letters.
Dina: That sounds nice!
Mother: I used to walk to school, but now I drive.
read.id:
Dina: Bu, apakah dulu Ibu bermain di luar?
Mother: Ya, dulu Ibu bermain dengan teman-teman setiap sore.
Dina: Apakah dulu Ibu punya ponsel?
Mother: Tidak, dulu kami tidak punya ponsel. Dulu kami menulis surat.
Dina: Kedengarannya menyenangkan!
Mother: Dulu Ibu berjalan kaki ke sekolah, tetapi sekarang Ibu menyetir.

qs.q: What did Mother use to write?

options: We didn't used to have phones.
I used to play with my friends.
Did you use to have a phone?
qs.exp: Setelah didn't: use to (bukan used to).

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "Did you ___ to have a phone?"
I ___ to play with my friends.
We didn't ___ to have phones.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dulu kami menulis surat."
